# Accessibility Degradation on S-TUN-003

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-TUN-01`
- **Confidence:** high (Change CHG-2026-0066 was executed on AGG-TUN-01 right before KPI degradation started at 02:00, followed by RRC failure alarms matching runbook signatures. Maintenance, external events, and other changes were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-27 02:00 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-27 02:03
- **Affected:** S-TUN-003, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-010, S-TUN-011, S-TUN-001, S-TUN-005

## Summary

A configuration push applying RAN parameter template OPT-21 (admission control, RRC timers) to aggregation router AGG-TUN-01 caused RRC setup failures and drop rate spikes across connected sites.

Poor accessibility on S-TUN-003 and peer sites started at 02:00 and remains ongoing as of 08:18.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-27 02:00: Earliest onset of KPI deviation; S-TUN-003 rrc_success_pct drops below baseline and drop_rate_pct spikes. [T7, ANM-000416, ANM-000417]
- 2026-09-27 02:03: Config push CHG-2026-0066 executed on aggregation router AGG-TUN-01, pushing RAN parameter template OPT-21. [CHG-2026-0066]
- 2026-09-27 02:25: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-TUN-011. [ALM-000609]
- 2026-09-27 02:30: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-TUN-002. [ALM-000610]
- 2026-09-27 02:38: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-TUN-010. [ALM-000611]

## Evidence

- S-TUN-003 suffered a drop rate spike and an RRC success rate drop starting around 02:00. [T1, T7, ANM-000416, ANM-000417]
- Aggregation router AGG-TUN-01 had configuration change CHG-2026-0066 applied at 02:03 pushing RAN parameter template OPT-21. [T4, CHG-2026-0066]
- Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarms were raised on multiple sites beneath AGG-TUN-01 following the change. [T3, ALM-000609, ALM-000610, ALM-000611]
- No maintenance windows or external events were recorded in the region during the incident timeframe. [T5, T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-TUN-01: confirmed. Configuration change CHG-2026-0066 pushing parameter template OPT-21 directly preceded the RRC success rate degradation and subsequent RRC failure alarms across connected sites. [CHG-2026-0066, T4, RB-ALARM-REFERENCE#05]
2. **transport_degradation** at LNK-TUN-01-A: rejected. Topology links and fiber paths showed no transport failures or related capacity blocks; alarms and changes point specifically to the aggregation router configuration push. [T2, T3, T4]

## Ruled out

- T5: No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-003, LNK-TUN-01-A, AGG-TUN-01, or parent nodes during the incident window.
- T6: No external events were recorded for region TUN.

## Recommended actions

- Roll back configuration change CHG-2026-0066 on AGG-TUN-01 to restore normal RRC timer and admission control parameters.
- Monitor RRC success rates and drop rates on S-TUN-003 and peer sites following rollback.
